title: Live checks after the test pass: one surface per sitting

intro.verdict_html: Everything built so far was exercised by automation on 20 November: 482 end-to-end checks as two people, 821 unit and database checks, and a pass that opens all 220 page views. Faults found were fixed or are on the build list. What is left here is only what a machine cannot judge: look, feel, a real voice, a real receipt, a second person's phone. Each chunk is one surface and about fifteen minutes; do them in any order, on any day. Chunk 1 is five minutes and should be first.
prerequisites: Chunk 3 needs the iPhone Shortcuts built first (their own checklist)
Chunk 11 needs the email service set up and the partner's phone
time: Twelve chunks: one of 5 minutes, one of 10, ten of 15
cost: Free, except Receipts: a few pence of cloud AI

phases.title: Signing in after the hardening (5 minutes, do this first)
phases.lede_html: The database now refuses a session that has not given its authenticator code, and one that was signed out elsewhere. Your own sign-in is the one thing only you can prove.

steps.title: Open the app on the PC
steps.body_html: If it asks for your authenticator code, enter it. That is the new rule working: a password alone no longer opens anything for an account that has an authenticator.

steps.title: Open the app on the phone
steps.body_html: Same: one code prompt at most, then everything as before. The installed app may need closing and reopening once.

steps.title: Sign a device out from the other
steps.body_html: Settings → Security → Sessions → Sign out there for the phone. The phone should land on the sign-in page at its next tap, not on empty cards.

steps.title: Telegram still answers
steps.body_html: Send the bot any short note. It should reply as before (it does not use a browser session, so nothing should have changed).

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

fields.label: Anything that locked you out or looked wrong

phases.title: Today, the finish line and the evening close (15 minutes; drop 9, 8, then 7)
phases.lede_html: The daily loop is new. Automation proves the rules (one win, up to four more, the soft limit, slipped dates, the 45-minute rule). Only you can say whether it feels right.

steps.title: Read the proposal
steps.body_html: One card: today's one thing, a first step, about how long. Under it, what comes next. Is the win the thing you would have picked? Is the time believable (it is your guess plus half again)?

steps.title: Looks right, then Start
steps.body_html: Press Looks right, then Start. A countdown runs and the ticket is in Doing. Press 10 more minutes once.

steps.title: Done
steps.body_html: Press Done. The card says the day is won and the next thing comes forward, with no count of what is left undone anywhere on the page.

steps.title: Not now and Swap
steps.body_html: On the next card press Not now: it goes without asking why. On the one after, Swap: two alternatives, pick one.

steps.title: Park
steps.body_html: Start something, then Park with a few words about where you left it. Tomorrow's card for it should show those words.

steps.title: Close the day
steps.body_html: In the evening open Close. It opens with what got done. Swipe or press through what is left (Done, Tomorrow, Let it go), then any capture cards (Accept, Fix, Discard), then Close the day. It should take under two minutes.

steps.title: A slipped date
steps.body_html: If something dated a week or more ago exists, it appears once as a card with three choices (new date, someday, drop) rather than at the front of today.

steps.title: The finish line
steps.body_html: Up to three things that are four-fifths done or more (by checklist or sub-tasks), each saying what is left. Try Good enough — close as is on one you will never polish. Are these the right three?

steps.title: Gone quiet
steps.body_html: The dashboard has a Gone quiet card and the matching menu entries are dimmed. It will name several things on day one, some months old: those are real gaps. Too blunt, about right, or are any of the rhythms wrong (a thing you do monthly marked after a week)?

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

fields.label: What felt wrong, slow, or badly worded

phases.title: Capture (15 minutes; after the Shortcuts are built; drop 7 first)
phases.lede_html: Capture was rebuilt: it answers at once, files afterwards, and keeps the recording. 113 automated checks pass. These are the parts only a phone and a voice can show.

steps.title: Shortcut, a task
steps.body_html: Say a task. Saved comes back at once; a push follows saying what it was filed as, and its link opens that card.

steps.title: A long dump
steps.body_html: Three or four things with "also…" and "another thing…". The push says it was saved as separate items; the evening close shows each as An idea for now. Suggested: … with from a longer recording.

steps.title: A reminder by voice
steps.body_html: "Remind me to call the dentist at 9am tomorrow" appears in Reminders for tomorrow 09:00 and shows once as a card. "Remind me to water the plants" is only a card.

steps.title: A recording with the PC on
steps.body_html: Send audio only (aeroplane mode, capture, then run Capture retry). Within a minute or so the card carries words the PC wrote, and the recording plays from the card.

steps.title: Hand edit wins
steps.body_html: Dictate, correct a word in the box, send. The stored text stays as you corrected it, even after the PC has transcribed the recording.

steps.title: The review queue
steps.body_html: There were about 40 captures waiting when the new queue went live. Anything older than seven days files itself tonight, tagged unreviewed. Check the list looks like yours and that the count on the dashboard matches.

steps.title: Weight
steps.body_html: "Weight 82.4 kg": Body shows it for today; the card reads Weight logged — 82.4 kg.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

fields.label: Wrong filings, lost words, anything slow

phases.title: Day log (15 minutes, an evening; drop 8 and 9 first)
phases.lede_html: Replaces the old live checks MYC-140, 142, 144 and 146. 30 automated checks pass; the conversation itself cannot be automated.

steps.title: The Telegram prompt
steps.body_html: At 21:30 the bot message reads "Evening. … Talk, Quick or Skip?" with its buttons; any calendar or weather it quotes is right.

steps.title: A Talk night
steps.body_html: Tap Talk, answer four or five questions, name someone not in People. One question per turn, "who's X?" once, no filler, no facts you did not say. Say "done", reply "4 3 5 2": a recap with a link and "N items to review".

steps.title: Today's entry
steps.body_html: The entry reads as your words (60 to 160 words, then one bullet per scene); scene cards in order with channel labels; cost at the bottom.

steps.title: Facts
steps.body_html: Open the "N TO REVIEW" badge; approve one fact and one who-was-there; edit that fact's text and kind on the day page, then delete it.

steps.title: Voice note and photo by Telegram
steps.body_html: While a day is open: the note appears as text; the photo lands on the scene you were describing after close.

steps.title: Capture form on the phone
steps.body_html: Tap +, pick Reminder, submit with no date: the message sits on the field, the keyboard does not cover the button, the Type dropdown works one-handed.

steps.title: Review card look
steps.body_html: With a typed capture waiting: readable, and APPROVE reachable without scrolling on the phone.

steps.title: Carry-over
steps.body_html: The night after one with a loose end, the opener starts "Last time you mentioned…".

steps.title: Linked user
steps.body_html: Needs a second account in a team with you; leave until the partner chunk.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: People and Quotes (15 minutes; drop 8, 7, 6 first)
phases.lede_html: Replaces MYC-136. 56 automated checks pass, including the rule that nothing ever creates a person by itself.

steps.title: Clear the review queue
steps.body_html: People → REVIEW NEEDED. KEEP any card that is a real person. Then SELECT → ALL → REJECT n and confirm: the list empties, with a notice giving the count and "words now ignored".

steps.title: Where they went
steps.body_html: Settings → People & teams: the Bin lists them with a "gone on" date; Ignored words lists their words as "rejected person".

steps.title: A rejected word stays gone
steps.body_html: Save a ticket whose title contains one of the rejected phrases; Entity review → NEW ENTITIES shows nothing new for it.

steps.title: Judge the queue's noise
steps.body_html: Look at what ticket titles have queued since 20 October. Tolerable, or should tickets link existing people only?

fields.label: Keep as is / link existing only

steps.title: One real voice quote
steps.body_html: Say "Quote from <someone in People>: …". The read-back; the review card with that person already picked; APPROVE; Quotes shows it at the top and the badge moves from "researching" to a verdict within a minute.

steps.title: Quotes on the phone
steps.body_html: The sheet comes up from the bottom, the text is large, the merch tick toggles in place.

steps.title: Export to the iPhone
steps.body_html: People → EXPORT .VCF, import on icloud.com: names, numbers and a custom label arrive intact.

steps.title: Review Needed on a touch screen
steps.body_html: KEEP / ARCHIVE / REJECT sit at reduced opacity until hover; check they are legible without one.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: Hours (15 minutes on a working day; drop 10, 9, 8 first)
phases.lede_html: MYC-177 already covers History against the workbook and the seed import; none of that is repeated. Four of these are decisions.

steps.title: The Log on the PC
steps.body_html: Type three real entries into the blank row with Enter, change a Time and a Ticket by tabbing into them, press Esc on one edit, then MERGE. It should feel as fast as the workbook.

fields.label: A click places the cursor (now) / a click selects the cell

steps.title: The Log on the phone
steps.body_html: The Description is squeezed to nothing at phone width. Say how a row should look there.

fields.label: How a phone row should look

steps.title: Dashboard beside the workbook
steps.body_html: Banner, Today pill, even pace and left today agree with the workbook's Dashboard.

steps.title: Daily, a bank-holiday or leave day
steps.body_html: Should "Total logged" include the day's credit (as now) or only ticked time (as the spec says)?

steps.title: Block-out email and calendar file
steps.body_html: OPEN BLOCK-OUT EMAIL and CALENDAR .ICS: the draft opens with the right people, subject and Friday's date; the file lands in Outlook as an all-day, free entry.

steps.title: Import a real week
steps.body_html: Copy a real week of Log rows from the workbook; Settings → Import, paste, DRY RUN: "To add" plus "Unchanged" equals the rows copied, nothing rejected.

steps.title: The spreadsheet download
steps.body_html: Settings → DOWNLOAD .XLSX, open in Excel: something you would send your team lead?

steps.title: Bank holidays
steps.body_html: Settings → REFRESH FROM GOV.UK: matches the real bank holidays.

steps.title: Ticket links
steps.body_html: Click two ticket keys on the Tickets view: they open the right Jira pages.

steps.title: Look
steps.body_html: The Daily week summary strip, a History week opened to its days, the Today tile Monday to Thursday.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: Receipts (15 minutes; uses cloud AI, a few pence; drop 8, 7, 6 first)
phases.lede_html: Receipts had never been run end to end before this pass; uploads could not have worked on production before today's storage fix.

steps.title: One real till receipt
steps.body_html: Upload a photo. Retailer, date and lines match the paper; status PARSED or NEEDS REVIEW with a believable reason.

steps.title: The totals panel
steps.body_html: Ctrl+Shift+H: RECEIPT TOTAL matches the paper; DIFFERENCE is zero or explains itself.

steps.title: A long receipt as two overlapping photos
steps.body_html: No line appears twice.

steps.title: Correct a line
steps.body_html: Correct one wrong line total and click away: badge and DIFFERENCE update.

steps.title: Split with someone
steps.body_html: Add a real person under SPLIT WITH, tap their chip on two lines, right-click a chip and set a percentage: figures read sensibly and are easy to hit on the phone.

steps.title: Balances
steps.body_html: Record a payment, open the receipt from under the card.

steps.title: One HEIC photo
steps.body_html: Is the message clear?

steps.title: The same receipt twice
steps.body_html: Upload it twice, tick both, Merge: wording clear, every page shown.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

fields.label: Wrong lines, wrong totals, anything confusing

phases.title: Gousto (15 minutes; drop 7, 6, 5 first)
phases.lede_html: The PC's weekly sync ran on 8 and 15 November and is next due 22 November at 03:00.

steps.title: The cookbook
steps.body_html: About 12,000 recipes, "SYNCED 15 Nov" or later, real photos.

steps.title: Search and filter
steps.body_html: Search "curry", pick a category, then a cuisine: counts believable; no category twice as "X" and "X Recipes".

steps.title: A recipe you have cooked
steps.body_html: Ingredients, allergens, nutrition and method match the Gousto card.

steps.title: A heart on the phone
steps.body_html: Tap a heart straight after typing a search: it lights and Favourites goes up.

steps.title: Save to my recipes
steps.body_html: SAVE TO MY RECIPES on one: it lands in My recipes and reaches a shopping list through a meal plan.

steps.title: Look on the phone
steps.body_html: Card grid, filter row, detail page.

steps.title: A recipe Gousto no longer serves
steps.body_html: Read the new wording.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: Work (15 minutes; drop 6 first)
phases.lede_html: Replaces MYC-111 and MYC-159. 59 automated checks pass as you and 13 as a second person.

steps.title: Issues on the phone
steps.body_html: Rows with labels and a due date still show their title; type two words in "Search text" at normal speed and both stay.

steps.title: A board, desktop then phone
steps.body_html: Drag a card to another column and between two cards; it stays after reload. On the phone, see whether dragging works at all (the Status picker on the issue is the fallback).

steps.title: An issue with no description
steps.body_html: Click Add, click Heading, type: it is a heading and the button is lit. Type @ and #: the list sits under the caret and a click picks. Judge the look of the chips.

steps.title: Project Settings
steps.body_html: Change the description, Save: "Saved" appears and the page does not flash. Archive a component: it stays, struck through, with Restore.

steps.title: Statuses and When
steps.body_html: Move a ticket through its statuses from the picker; set When to a date and to Someday. The lists it appears in should follow.

steps.title: Backlog with a running sprint
steps.body_html: The look of the sprint block and burndown. The line will not move yet: that is a known fault on the build list, not something to report.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

steps.title: History and restore
steps.body_html: Edit a page twice, open History: is the diff readable? Restore the older version: the page shows it at once.

steps.title: The page menu
steps.body_html: It closes on Escape and on a click outside; "Save as a template…" lists the page under Templates.

steps.title: Notification settings
steps.body_html: Settings, the Notifications section: the Telegram, Email and Push columns can be ticked; "Subscribe this device" works on the phone. The inbox itself will be empty: with one member nothing produces a notification yet (on the build list).

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: Before the partner joins (15 minutes, with her phone; needs the email service first)
phases.lede_html: 59 automated checks pass and all nine access faults found by the test pass are closed. This chunk waits on the email service being set up (a separate item in your queue): until then invites are not emailed.

steps.title: Read this first
steps.body_html: Do not make her an admin, and do not name her successor, until she has set up an authenticator. Owners and admins must have one; without it her account shows only the page that sets one up.

notes.html: If it happens anyway, nothing is lost: she is taken to Settings → Security, sets up the authenticator, and everything opens again.

steps.title: Decide: does she set one up on day one?
steps.body_html: Without an authenticator she works normally but cannot share with you or open "Who has seen my data".

steps.title: The invite email
steps.body_html: People & teams → family team → invite her real address as member: "Invite created." with no link shown; an email within a minute, not in spam; the link opens the production site.

steps.title: Joining on her phone
steps.body_html: She opens the link and chooses Password: "Check your email", a confirmation email, tapping it returns to the invite page signed in, Accept shows "You are in … as member". Repeat once opening the confirmation on a different device.

steps.title: A real authenticator
steps.body_html: Settings → Security → Enrol: the QR scans, the code is accepted. Sign out, sign in with password: it asks for the code. Sign in once by magic link: it asks too.

steps.title: Sharing
steps.body_html: People & teams → Share with a person → her email → Organisation, tickets, view → Share. It sends you to Security to confirm your code and brings you back; fill in the share again. On her phone it appears under Shared with me, and she can open but not edit your project.

steps.title: The Day log, day by day
steps.body_html: Share Journal with her (view). On her phone, Journal shows nothing of yours. Now open one of your finished days and press Private so it reads Shared: on her phone that day appears under Shared with me with your summary and scenes, and nothing else. Press it back to Private: it is gone.

steps.title: A nudge
steps.body_html: On her phone she opens one of your shared tickets and presses Nudge → Want company for this? You get a notification; on the new Home it is a margin note with Not today. Finish the ticket: within five minutes she is told.

steps.title: Sign her phone out from your laptop
steps.body_html: Settings → Security → Sign out there for her phone's session. Her phone should stop showing data at once and land on the sign-in page.

steps.title: Admin
steps.body_html: /admin: a prompt to confirm the code, then the console listing both users, the family team, the grants and an audit tab.

steps.title: Phone layout
steps.body_html: People & teams and Security on her phone: the section table scrolls sideways, the share form is usable, the QR is large enough to scan from another screen.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: The new shell and Specimen plate (15 minutes, on the PC; drop 7 first)
phases.lede_html: Behind a switch, so nothing changes until you flip it, and Classic is one tap back. Checked by automation for behaviour; only you can say whether it is what you pictured.

steps.title: Switch it on
steps.body_html: Settings → Appearance → Shell → New. The page reloads with a menu bar across the top and no sidebar.

steps.title: The menu bar
steps.body_html: Open each dropdown. Is everything where you would look for it? The groups are one line of code each to change: say which to move.

steps.title: The plate
steps.body_html: Home is the day as a field-guide page: the win as the large specimen with its four notes, the rest as figures. Move the pointer across it: the threads lean away. Is this what you pictured? More, less, different?

steps.title: Done
steps.body_html: Press Done — colour it in on something you have really finished. Colour floods in, new growth comes from the specimen, the spore print gains a ray. Is the moment big enough?

steps.title: Bring a figure to the centre
steps.body_html: Click a small figure: it becomes the annotated specimen. Not now sets it aside; Start with a timer opens the focus card.

steps.title: An inner page
steps.body_html: Open People or Hours: the page itself is unchanged, with its sub-pages as a row of chips under the bar. Anything now harder to reach than it was in the sidebar?

steps.title: The phone
steps.body_html: On the phone Home is still the single next-thing card, and the tab bar is as before.

steps.title: Stay or switch back
steps.body_html: Leave it on New if you want to live with it; Classic is in the same place.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: The family space (20 minutes, the two of you, after she has joined; drop 12, 11, 10 first)
phases.lede_html: Built and checked by automation with two test people. It lives in a team, so the first two steps are yours. Nothing here touches the finance section. Do not fill in Born on until it is true: it changes the page from weeks to the baby's age.

steps.title: Make the team
steps.body_html: People & teams → create a team ("Family" or your surname). It asks for your authenticator code. Invite her as member if she is not in it yet.

steps.title: Make it the family space
steps.body_html: Open Family (under Organisation; in the new shell under Life). It offers the team: press Use …. The page opens with three lists already filled in.

steps.title: The due date
steps.body_html: Press Dates, enter the due date, Save. The heading becomes Week N with the days to go and, on some weeks, a line from the standard NHS schedule. Is the week the one your midwife uses?

steps.title: Everything here is shared
steps.body_html: Each of you sees, once, a note that everything added here is seen by the other, with Understood. Ask her: is that what she wants, or would she like a switch for private notes? It is a small change if so.

fields.label: Fine as it is / she wants private notes

steps.title: A note and a picture
steps.body_html: On her phone, Timeline: add a note, then a second entry with a photo from the camera roll. Both appear on yours within a few seconds, each marked with the week. A photo over 4 MB is refused in words; say if that bites.

steps.title: Say it instead
steps.body_html: Use the capture Shortcut and say "Family: we heard the heartbeat today". It lands on the timeline in those words, not in your own captures. Then say something with the word family in the middle ("book a family holiday"): that one is filed as usual.

steps.title: An appointment
steps.body_html: Add an appointment for tomorrow morning with a place. It shows under Coming up. You should each get a notification this evening from six, and another two hours before it.

steps.title: Names
steps.body_html: Each add two names and vote on all four. A name you both like moves to the top with you both like it; one of you changing a vote moves it back.

steps.title: The lists
steps.body_html: On the PC: click a price cell, type a price, press Enter (it moves down), Tab (it moves across). Tick one as bought. The running total under each heading follows. Type a new line at the bottom and press Enter.

fields.label: Anything missing from the starter lists

steps.title: A letter, aloud
steps.body_html: On your phone, Letters: read this week's question, press Answer aloud, talk for half a minute, press Stop. The recording is there at once; its words appear beneath it within a few minutes while the PC is on. Then she answers the same question.

fields.label: Words appeared / did not / wrong words

steps.title: The baby log
steps.body_html: It works now, so try it: Baby log → Feed, Nappy, Asleep, then Awake. Each is one tap; Undo removes one. Do one from each phone: both show the same list. Is anything you would want at three in the morning more than one tap away?

steps.title: Household
steps.body_html: Add your bins (pick any day one is collected, and how often): it says when the next one is. Add a warranty with its PDF or a photo of the receipt and the date it runs out.

steps.title: The budget
steps.body_html: Each add two things you have paid this month. The top says what each of you paid and what would make it even. Check that nothing from your own Finance pages appears here, and nothing from here appears there.

steps.title: Anything to report
steps.body_html: A few words are enough. Leave empty if it was all fine. What you write here is read at the start of the next build session.

phases.title: Finance: bills, budget and the categorising (15 minutes, on the PC; drop 7, 6 first)
phases.lede_html: Built and checked by automation with seeded transactions. Owner-only: nothing here can be shared, and nothing is in a page until amounts are shown. The bank data on production stops on 17 July 2026; a CSV import in step 5 brings it forward.

steps.title: Bills, amounts hidden
steps.body_html: Open Finance → Bills with amounts hidden (the eye in the top bar). Nothing readable: no merchant, no figure, anywhere on the page.

steps.title: Bills, amounts shown
steps.body_html: Show amounts. The list is what leaves each month, the subscriptions you have not said anything about first, costliest first. Do the amounts and rhythms match what you know? Anything missing, or anything that is not a bill?

steps.title: Say Keep, Cancel it, Not a bill
steps.body_html: Press Keep on one, Cancel it on one and Not a bill on one. The cancelled one moves to To cancel; the not-a-bill one leaves the totals and sits under a fold with Put it back. Reload: the three are remembered.

steps.title: Budget
steps.body_html: Finance → Budget. With amounts shown, type a monthly figure for two categories (Enter moves down). Step back with ← to July: each category shows spent against budget up to the day the data reaches, and Heading for where the month was going.

steps.title: Import, then the categories arrive by themselves
steps.body_html: On Spending, import the most recent CSV from one bank. Give it a minute, reload: the new rows have categories without pressing Categorise. (A few pence of cloud AI for the ones the memory did not know.)

fields.label: How many arrived uncategorised after a minute?

steps.title: The unsure ones at the evening close
steps.body_html: That evening, open the close. After today's items and any captures, Spending to place: a card per payment the model was unsure about, Looks like Groceries?. Yes on one, Fix on another (pick the category), Not now on a third. Next morning the first two no longer appear.

steps.title: A morning line
steps.body_html: The morning after the import, at most one line about money: a category over four-fifths of its budget, or a payment larger than usual. It names a percentage or a count, never an amount. Did one arrive, and did it name an amount?

phases.title: Finance: net worth with by-hand holdings (10 minutes, on the PC)
phases.lede_html: Built and checked by automation as two people. Owner-only; nothing in the page until amounts are shown. A figure keeps the date it was true on, so the line is honest about how old each one is.

steps.title: Net worth, hidden then shown
steps.body_html: Finance → Snapshot. Amounts hidden: the Net worth panel shows no name and no figure, the chart is not drawn, Add a holding is greyed. Show amounts: the panel shows the sheet's latest figure as the total, no holdings yet.

steps.title: Add the pension
steps.body_html: Add a holding: kind Pension, its name, the figure from the latest statement, the statement's date as True on. The total rises by that amount; the row says how old the figure is.

steps.title: House, mortgage, cars
steps.body_html: Add the house (Property) and the mortgage (Mortgage, typed as what is owed; the row reads owed and the total falls by it). Add each car as Vehicle.

steps.title: The monthly pension item
steps.body_html: One new recurring item Update the pension figure, due the 1st of next month, exactly once.

steps.title: A new figure, in place
steps.body_html: Type a new pension figure straight into its cell, Enter. The row reads today, the line gains a step at today, and the old figure still stands on the earlier part of the line.

steps.title: Does the sheet include Investments?
steps.body_html: Say whether the sheet's net-worth figure already includes the Investments page's holdings. If it does not, a one-line change is ready to add today's Investments value to the line.

phases.title: The weekly close-out, the month's measures, timed notices, the Boys' group (20 minutes; step 8 after MYC-203)
phases.lede_html: Built and checked by automation as Tess. The close-out is the one session that only finishes; nothing here keeps a streak that can break.

steps.title: Set the week's slot
steps.body_html: The week — when it closes: set a day and time you will keep (default Sunday 18:00). Ten minutes before it, one line arrives: The week's close-out starts in 10 min., counted as one of the day's three.

steps.title: Begin the close-out
steps.body_html: Type one line for what the forty-five minutes will do, Begin. The box counts down; This week and Lifetime read right against what you remember (win days, finished of started; the totals).

steps.title: Gone quiet: Keep / Pause / Retire
steps.body_html: The Gone quiet card names the section with the biggest gap and asks why. Write a sentence; press Keep, Pause or Retire. The dashboard still marks it quiet (a decision changes the question, not the marks). Next week it is not asked about again (four weeks for a pause).

steps.title: A finish-line card
steps.body_html: Anything above 80% done and untouched for a fortnight is a card: Finish / Good enough / Drop. Swipe one.

steps.title: Close the week
steps.body_html: Type the week's Screen Time from the phone, one line for how it went, Close the week. Reload: Week closed. with the report under it. Close it again: nothing changes.

steps.title: The month, measured (first close-out of December)
steps.body_html: Eight rows for November beside a dash column (no October yet), and the two questions with Kirsty under the report box. Answer them; they are kept on the row and read back the month after.

fields.label: Do the eight rows make sense? (yes / which not)

steps.title: Notices before a timed ticket
steps.body_html: Give any ticket a time about ten minutes ahead. Two lines arrive, from about ten minutes out and about five, each with the true gap; on the Today card a running timer says Ten minutes left. and Two minutes left. Find a stopping place. Start a focus timer first: the ticket's notice still arrives; a morning briefing would not.

steps.title: The Boys' group (after MYC-203)
steps.body_html: After the bots exist (MYC-203: seven bots, one group, eight env names, one POST to the setup route): in the group, Coach, what's tomorrow's session? is answered by the Coach's bot as itself; Morning all by Da Boi alone; a spending question by The Advisor; a reply to a bot's message by that bot.

phases.title: The Finds feed (10 minutes; step 6 optional)
phases.lede_html: Built and checked by automation against saved fixtures. No scraper and no paid API: posts come in by Share, and the watchers read GitHub, Hacker News, feeds and advisories on their own. Nothing is ever installed automatically.

steps.title: Share a post in
steps.body_html: From the X app, share a post to Mycelium (or paste a GitHub link with three words into the capture box). The reply says Kept as a find: … and names the words you typed, not the URL.

steps.title: The find gets a verdict
steps.body_html: Studio → Finds. The shared link is at the top of today with no verdict yet. With the PC on, within a few minutes it has a verdict badge; open the line and read what, cost, licence, cautions and which project. Say Keep or Skip.

steps.title: Your own feed
steps.body_html: Switch the Vercel blog feed off and add one feed of your own (any RSS or Atom address). Tomorrow's turn reads it; the sources panel shows when it was last read and how many it saw.

steps.title: Export
steps.body_html: Export. The Markdown opens with the same columns as the design-resources record, the three verdict lists, and the install advice at the end.

steps.title: Sunday's digest, and the close-out cards
steps.body_html: Sunday after five: one Telegram message, This week's finds, a count and a few lines, no amounts. In the weekly close-out, the top five are cards after the finish-line ones: Keep or Skip.

steps.title: Optional: a GitHub token
steps.body_html: MYC-202: add GITHUB_TOKEN in Vercel and redeploy. Nothing visible changes; the daily turn is less likely to hit a rate limit.

phases.title: The wall screen (15 minutes; needs a phone or the frame)
phases.lede_html: Built and checked by automation. The wall is an ordinary family-team member with one scoped token in a cookie; a person's own view needs their PIN and lasts ten minutes; the screen never holds anyone's session, and nothing from Finance reaches it.

steps.title: A PIN each
steps.body_html: Quick unlock: set a PIN. Ask Kirsty to set hers on her phone (same card).

steps.title: Add a wall
steps.body_html: Walls: Team Family, name Kitchen, Add wall. An eight-digit code appears; it is shown once and lasts ten minutes.

steps.title: Pair the screen
steps.body_html: On the frame (or the phone for now), open /wall and type the code. The family board appears: both names, the countdown, the week's appointments, weather and bins.

steps.title: Your own view
steps.body_html: Tap your name, type your PIN. Your day appears with the next thing large. Tap Done on something: the chime. Tap Read my morning: the voice. Tap Tap to talk, say something, tap again: it is in Captures within a minute.

fields.label: Voice and capture worked? (yes / which not)

steps.title: Leave it alone
steps.body_html: After two minutes it is back on the family board on its own; after three more it is the ambient plate; a touch brings the board back.

steps.title: Guest
steps.body_html: Tap Guest. Only the clock, the weather and the pictures; hold the faint mark top-right for two seconds to come back.

steps.title: Revoke and pair the real frame
steps.body_html: Walls → Revoke when you are done with the phone, and pair the real frame with a new wall (MYC-205 has the pairing steps).

steps.title: Which frame?
steps.body_html: If the frame has no browser or no way to a kiosk app, pick a line from the report's costed table and say which (MYC-182).
